hypothesis: A unified user workflow with topology-aware efficient placement, not merely a new transport protocol or a collection of wrapped tools.
baseline_candidates: Configured Looking Glass plus local input/audio routing
scenario: Desk-to-laptop-to-desk operation with one real application and two actual nodes. Then add a same-host VM route. Keep keyboard/mouse ownership exclusive, switch presentation/audio, transfer one clipboard/file item and recover from a disconnect. Measure each locality cohort separately while background build/inference load runs.
failure_cases: Stale input lease causes duplicate control
Secret clipboard delivered to wrong session
Disconnect loses or repeats an action
metrics: User steps and time to restore workspace
